content:
**Ally: Pet Peeve** is an ally quest for Beckett in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update.

Edwin's "dog," Noodles, has gone missing, rendering Edwin unable to help Beckett. Go to Johnson's Acre for the purpose of finding Noodles. Of course, Johnson's Acre has been turned into a Cult of the Mothman base with shrines to the Mothman, so the cultists will have to be dealt with before finding Noodles. One will soon discover that Noodles is not stationary, but rather moving quite quickly. After catching up with Noodles, it is revealed that he is not a dog but rather a mole rat, a glowing one as well. "Free" Noodles and return to Beckett to complete the quest.
